name: Spiritualism
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of spiritualism, including consulting familiar spirits, wizards, and necromancers, as abominations that defile the people of God. The Lord commands His people not to seek or learn from these practices, warning that those who turn to such occult activities will face severe judgment, including being cut off from the community or even death. These prohibitions emphasize God's holiness and the necessity for His people to remain separate from the pagan customs of surrounding nations.
